purpose: Three-position Light, System, Dark switch on a quiet sky and night track, for choosing a color theme.
useWhen: Letting a person choose between a light theme, a dark theme, and following their system setting.
Placing the theme choice in a header, a user menu, or a settings page as one compact control.

avoidWhen.reason: Flipping a single setting on or off — use toggle instead.
Picking one option from a longer list of labeled choices — use segmented-control instead.
